reason: Section 65.3 lists the annual customer, delivery-volume, and Board-requested information a licensee must provide.

evidenceText: shall provide the following information to the Board on an annual basis
names and addresses of its customers
quantity of gas the licensee delivered

proposedGroups.reason: The section is one annual reporting duty with three listed categories of information.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall the information a licensee must provide annually to the Board.

reason: Section 65.31 states the non-transferability of a licence.

evidenceText: licence is not transferable

proposedGroups.reason: The section contains one legal effect for licences.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recognize that a licence cannot be transferred.

reason: Section 65.32 requires corporate licensees to notify the Board of amalgamation activity and permits licence amendment.

evidenceText: enters into an amalgamation agreement or amalgamates
shall immediately advise the Board in writing
may amend the licence

proposedGroups.reason: The section connects corporate amalgamation events to immediate written Board notice and possible licence amendment.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall the Board notice and licence-amendment rule when a corporate licensee amalgamates or enters an amalgamation agreement.

reason: Section 65.4 requires immediate written Board notice when a licensee changes name and permits licence amendment.

evidenceText: If a licensee changes its name
shall immediately advise the Board in writing
may amend the licence

proposedGroups.reason: The section contains one name-change notice and amendment rule.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall what a licensee must do after changing its name and what amendment the Board may make.

reason: Section 65.41 is a coherent licence cancellation and reapplication provision covering cancellation grounds, new application, and remedy-based reissuance.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Licence cancellation and remedy-based new licence

evidenceText: may cancel a licence if the licensee
may apply to the Board for a new licence
fully remedied the circumstances

proposedGroups.reason: The subsections together identify cancellation grounds and how a cancelled licensee may obtain a new licence.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall the grounds for licence cancellation and the conditions for applying for and receiving a new licence after cancellation.

reason: Section 65.42 prohibits receiving delivered gas at distribution-area eligible facilities during the specified period without an approval, except for vehicle gas fuelling stations.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Approval required to receive delivered gas in distribution area

evidenceText: No person who owns or operates an eligible facility
shall receive gas by delivery
unless the person holds an approval

proposedGroups.reason: The section states the recipient-side approval requirement and the gas fuelling station exception.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall when an owner or operator of an eligible facility in the distribution area may receive gas by delivery.

reason: Section 65.5 sets eligibility, form, information, and fee requirements for approval applications for eligible facilities.

evidenceText: may apply for an approval for the eligible facility
shall be made to the Board
may assess a processing fee

proposedGroups.reason: The subsections together describe who may apply for approval and how the application must be submitted and paid for.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall who may apply for an eligible facility approval and the form, information, and fee requirements for the application.

reason: Section 65.51 requires the Board to give the general franchise holder a copy of an approval application when received.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Copy of approval application to general franchise holder

evidenceText: On receipt of an application for an approval
shall provide the general franchise holder with a copy

proposedGroups.reason: The section is one application-copying duty.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall who receives a copy of an approval application after the Board receives it.

reason: Section 65.52 provides the objection process for approval applications, including the 30-day filing period, copy to the applicant, and mandatory hearing if an objection is filed.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: General franchise holder objection to approval application

evidenceText: Within 30 days after receiving a copy
notice of objection
shall provide the applicant with a copy
shall hold a hearing

proposedGroups.reason: The subsections form one objection workflow from filing through applicant notice and hearing.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall how the general franchise holder may object to an approval application and what the Board must do after an objection is filed.

reason: Section 65.6 authorizes approval issuance when there is no objection, objections are withdrawn, or the Board finds after hearing that issuance is in the public interest.

evidenceText: Board may issue an approval if
no notice of objection
all objections have been withdrawn
public interest to issue the approval

proposedGroups.reason: The section lists the alternative conditions under which the Board may issue an approval.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall when the Board may issue an approval for an eligible facility.

reason: Section 65.61 authorizes the Board to impose appropriate terms and conditions on an approval.

evidenceText: may impose any terms and conditions
on an approval

proposedGroups.reason: The section is a single approval-condition authority.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall that the Board may impose terms and conditions it considers appropriate on an approval.

reason: Section 65.62 prohibits an approved customer from transferring or assigning an approval without prior written Board approval.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Board approval for transfer or assignment of approval

evidenceText: shall not transfer or assign an approval
without the prior written approval of the Board

proposedGroups.reason: The section states one restriction on approval transfer or assignment.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall when an approved customer may transfer or assign an approval.

reason: Section 65.7 requires corporate approved customers to notify the Board of amalgamation activity and permits approval amendment.

evidenceText: enters into an amalgamation agreement or amalgamates
shall immediately advise the Board in writing
may amend the approval

proposedGroups.reason: The section connects corporate amalgamation events to immediate written Board notice and possible approval amendment.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall the notice and amendment rule when a corporate approved customer amalgamates or enters an amalgamation agreement.

reason: Section 65.71 requires immediate written Board notice when an approved customer changes name and permits approval amendment.

evidenceText: If an approved customer changes its name
shall immediately advise the Board in writing
may amend the approval

proposedGroups.reason: The section contains one name-change notice and amendment rule for approved customers.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall what an approved customer must do after changing its name and what amendment the Board may make.

reason: Section 65.72 is a coherent approval cancellation and reapplication provision covering cancellation grounds, new application, and remedy-based reissuance.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Approval cancellation and remedy-based new approval

evidenceText: may cancel an approval for an eligible facility
may apply to the Board for a new approval
fully remedied the circumstances

proposedGroups.reason: The subsections together identify cancellation grounds and how a person may obtain a new approval after cancellation.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall the grounds for cancellation of an approval and the conditions for applying for and receiving a new approval after cancellation.

reason: Section 65.8 exempts gas fuelling station owners or operators in the distribution area from obtaining an approval.

evidenceText: owner or operator of a gas fuelling station
located in the distribution area
is exempt from the requirement to obtain an approval

proposedGroups.reason: The section states one approval exemption for vehicle gas fuelling stations in the distribution area.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall the approval exemption for owners or operators of distribution-area vehicle gas fuelling stations.

reason: Section 65.81 requires the Board to issue approval to existing delivery customers if they provide proof of pre-commencement and continued delivery plus any other relevant information within six months.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Approval for delivery before section commencement

evidenceText: immediately before the date of the commencement of this section
within six months after the date of the commencement
Board shall issue an approval

proposedGroups.reason: The section is one transitional approval route for customers already receiving delivery at commencement.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall the proof, timing, and information requirements for approval when a customer was receiving gas delivery before section commencement.

reason: Section 65.9 requires the Board to issue approval to customers receiving delivery before an area became part of the distribution area if they provide proof of prior and continued delivery plus other relevant information within six months.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Approval for delivery before area joins distribution area

evidenceText: area of the Province becomes part of the distribution area
within six months after the date on which the area becomes part
Board shall issue an approval

proposedGroups.reason: The section is one approval route for customers already receiving delivery when their area enters the distribution area.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall the proof, timing, and information requirements for approval when a customer was receiving gas delivery before the area became part of the distribution area.
